Question: How much can you make from day trading? What type of lifestyle do/did you have as a day trader?
Answer: You can make 25–30% an year on your capital. Some years more and some years less. Harsh truth Those who succeed in trading get the work done even when they don;t feel like it. They study their trades, they prepare for different scenarios. They go back to the drawing board over and over again. The “trading lifestyle” is not always sexy. Success is also not guaranteed. It’s on you to put in the effort and grab it with your own hands. Trading is a high level skill that can give you financial freedom and generational wealth. For some reason, I have seen so many people treat this lightly and fall short with their results. Youtube won’t cut it. If it did, every person out there would be living the trader life. Yet there are only a handful that actually make it to the top. Be prepared to what it takes to stand at the top. I will be waiting for you to make it up here.

Question: How can someone make a living as a full-time trader? What are some key elements that need to be put into consideration?
Answer: Trading is the hardest way to make easy money. This means, there are few things you are going to need to get right to make a career out of this. The 1st. Understanding that trading is not a get-rich-quick scheme. You need to re-wire your mindset to long term growth to really see the success you see from traders on social media. If you don’t, you are probably going to end up quitting within the first year. The 2nd. Educate yourself. It’s no hope watching one video on Youtube and believing that you can trade. Trading requires a deep understanding of price action, human behavior and risk management. Focus on becoming a student of the game. Do this by learning : The 3rd. This is probably the most underrated step I see so many beginners skipping. Practice! Once you have learnt a little bit, you are going to need to practice. Use a demo account to back test and build your trading strategy. It’s no good wasting your hard earned cash by gambling on a strategy that’s not proven. It’s a waste of time and money, take the time to practice. The 4th. Master risk management. Capital preservation is so much more important than capital gains. It’s great making money from trading but the real secret is learning how to keep the profits you make. Focus on : The 5th and final. Continued improvement and consistency is key and I don’t mean just turning up every day. I mean constantly tracking your trades using a trading journal to reflect on what’s working, what isn’t and what can be improved. The beauty of trading is there’s always some slight adjustment that can be made to make our trading plan more efficient.

Question: Should I just give up trading in the stockmarket?
Answer: The next time you think of giving up, think of this image. Imagine if he gave up? There would be no amazon. He would have never reached the Forbes billionaires list or discovered his full potential. Now I want to ask you, why do you want to give up? Why are you giving up on trading or life? Do you not want more? Let me explain this very simply. Imagine two parallel universes. On one side you have a boss, struggle week to week are depressed and want it all to end. On the other, you have everything you dreamed of. The funny things is, you are not light years away from this. There is no need to crossover to parallel universes. You are just one decision and hard work away. Discover your full potential before you quit.

Name: Shraddha Nanchahil
Question: How should I trade in nifty option with profit of ₹1000 everyday?
Answer: In order to be successful, you have to stay in the game. To stay in the game, your focus should be on learning and you have to be willing to pour your heart into it. This is the process. The biggest shift in your trading results will come when you stop focusing on the results ironically. When you shift to gaining clarity about your strategy and follow through on your plan day by day, you build confidence in yourself and your process. As you trust your process, you will learn what works and what doesn’t. The goal is not to make money everyday because some days there are not any opportunities present. The goal each day is to be ready to act if an opportunity presents itself and if there isn’t then don’t force yourself to trade. This process of trading is what differentiates someone who is interested in trading and someone who is committed to trading.

Question: What are the skills / knowledge needed to become a good day-trader?
Answer: Patience and perseverance are the silent warriors of trading, quietly leading you through the storms to brighter days. They are not flashy but they are the back bone of any trader who has made it through the storm. Every set back, every hard day, that’s your training ground. It is in those moments that champions are made. You want to see brighter days? You have got to fight through the dark ones with everything you have got. No excuses, no shortcuts. Stay focused and push through.
